name: Otose... Iyagaru Ano Ko o Biyaku de Otose!
original_name: 堕トセ… 嫌がるあの娘を媚薬で堕トセ!
source:
Shibutada likes games, anime, and, of course, ero games.... Yes, he is a perfect otaku. One day, he receives a wrongly delivered package. But Sawa, his younger sister, opens it and eats chocolate inside the package.... A while later, her attitude gradually changes.... It seems the chocolate she ate is a love drug....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
涉忠喜歡遊戲、動漫，當然還有色情遊戲……是的，他是個不折不扣的阿宅。有一天，他收到了一個寄錯的包裹。但他的妹妹澤打開了它，吃了裡面的巧克力……過了一會兒，她的態度漸漸變了……看來她吃的巧克力是催情藥……

[出自ErogeShop]
